name: register-tab
title: Login Register Tab
description: A centred dark auth card with a small two-pill mode switch above it. Login offers Google, Apple and Facebook buttons, email and password fields and a white submit; Register adds a username and phone number.
use: A small product needs a self-contained sign-in panel with social options and a register mode.
avoid: The form is a shell: no submit handler, validation or state, and every field and colour is hard-coded.
a11y: Fields rely on placeholders instead of labels, the icon-only social buttons have no name, and focus outlines are removed. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall rounded near-black card on a black stage, topped by a pale rounded logo tile, a bold Welcome Back heading and a muted line under it. Three bordered social buttons run across, then an OR rule, two dark input fields and a white Sign in button.
behaves: Pressing Login or Register swaps the panel below the switch: the old card fades out while the new one fades in, so both are briefly visible. Social buttons lighten on hover, and the fields lose any focus outline.
customise: No props: headings, placeholder text, panel copy and social icons are written in the file, and the widths and colours are hard-coded classes.
weight: light: One card, a few inputs and inline icon graphics; only the panel switch animates.
demo: Welcome Back and Register Account headings, with Google, Apple and Facebook sign-in buttons.
issues: Frames 2 and 5 catch both panels mid-fade, so two headings and two forms overlap.
Icon-only social buttons carry no accessible name and fields have no labels.
The white Sign in button has no hover state, unlike the social buttons.
polishWhy: Tidy dark card with clear modes; the cross-fade doubles the forms and controls look stock.
